parsed.rationale: Both `PlayerState.description` (PlayerState.swift:105) and `PlaybackState.description` (PlaybackState.swift:109) are computed properties that conform to `CustomStringConvertible` on two distinct domain types within the same `Playback` package. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.857), `description` implementations on enums or state types are inherently short and formulaic — their structural similarity is a natural consequence of both types implementing the same Swift standard-library protocol, not evidence of accidental duplication. The two types encode distinct domain concepts (`PlayerState` vs `PlaybackState`) and their `description` bodies almost certainly enumerate different cases. Extracting or sharing the implementation would conflate unrelated state machines and reduce clarity.
